input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term"). Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: Paragraph 4(a) provides automatic 1-year renewals (the renewal term length is acceptable and not multi-year, so not walk-away territory), but the only mechanism for Customer to exit a renewal is the 90-day for-convenience notice right that arises after the Initial Term. A 90-day exit notice fails the fallback of a non-renewal window of no more than 60 days, so this is a material deviation. We shortened Customer's notice to 30 days (preferred position) while leaving Kubient's notice at 90 days, since a shorter Vendor exit right would not benefit us. There is no renewal price-uplift language in the Agreement (Kubient is compensated out of auction fees rather than a Customer subscription fee) and no Vendor renewal reminder; the absent reminder mechanic is noted but not separately flagged.

proposal.summary: Shorten Customer's post-Initial Term exit notice from 90 days to 30 days (Kubient's notice unchanged at 90 days)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms but we can only exit on ninety (90) days' notice; our playbook allows an opt-out window of no more than 30 days (60 days as a fallback), so we have shortened our notice period while leaving Kubient's at ninety (90) days. We are comfortable with the 12-month renewal term as drafted.

ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to Kubient, and Kubient may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to Customer.
